disclaimer: Reminder reference only — NOT legal authority. Season dates, zones, and limits are set annually and can change. Always verify current regulations with the Pennsylvania Game Commission before hunting or trapping.

license_summary.bobcat_fisher_otter_permits: In addition to a furtaker license, a special permit is required for bobcat, fisher, and river otter. Licensed furtakers may obtain one permit each per license year.
license_summary.coyote_hunting: A furtaker license is NOT required to hunt coyotes — a general hunting license suffices. A furtaker license IS required to trap coyotes.
license_summary.furtaker_license: A furtaker license is required to hunt or trap any furbearer, except that coyotes may be hunted on a hunting license and porcupines may be hunted with a hunting or furtaker license. Licenses valid July 1, 2026 – June 30, 2027.
license_summary.porcupine: Porcupines may be hunted with a hunting or furtaker license.

seasons.notes: No closed season. Outside of any big game season (deer, bear, elk, turkey), coyotes may be taken with a hunting license or furtaker license without wearing orange. verification.confirmation_notes: All season dates, WMU lists, and permit rules are from final approved 2026–27 seasons published by the PA Game Commission (pa.gov newsroom release and the PGC seasons-and-bag-limits page, both current). Fisher confirmed as trapping-only (listed under trapping seasons, not hunting). Porcupine confirmed under PGC furbearer seasons (hunting only). Beaver season dates and 'limits vary by WMU' officially confirmed; per-WMU limit numbers carry a provenance caveat (see known_gaps).
known_gaps: Per-WMU beaver daily/season limits were transcribed from a third-party-hosted copy of the official 2026–27 digest (the pa.gov digest PDF download failed on 2026-09-18). Dates and 'limits vary by WMU' are officially confirmed, but the limit NUMBERS must be confirmed against the official digest before being treated as authoritative.
Bobcat/fisher/river otter pelt tagging and check-in mechanics for 2026–27 were not confirmed from an official source in hand; the permit requirement is confirmed.
No explicitly closed furbearer species found in official PA sources; none modeled.
Scientific names are standard taxonomy, NOT stated in the PGC sources used; all marked scientific_name_verified=false. Weasel is null because regulations do not distinguish weasel species.
Nuisance/depredation take is noted but not modeled as a season.
Full trap-device regulations (cable-restraint specs, body-grip placement, trap tending intervals) are excluded per schema scope; only the brief cable-restraint season note is included.
